author_note: Read only the 13 workflows/*.yaml contracts and scripts/workflow_registry.py (registry skimmed for action names, artifact types and control definitions). Each gold follows from quoted contract text: controls and their stated ranges/rules for S items, input_artifacts/handoff_contract/conventions for D items, request-level limits (minimum samples, genes>samples, kmax<=samples, 20,000,000-value LIONESS-DRAGON limit recomputed as F(F-1)/2 x samples) for size checks, and registered artifact types for out-of-scope requests. ASK items have one open fact whose two answers lead to different contract outcomes and is not settled by a default or by a file already present; items were shuffled with random.Random(20261025).
review_note: Independent gold review: read only AUTHOR-BRIEF.md, items-author.json, the 13 workflows/*.yaml contracts and the relevant parts of scripts/workflow_registry.py (registered controls table, CONDOR capability, handoff-consumer logic, practical notes). For each of the 48 items I re-derived the call from quoted contract text: controls, ranges and combination rules for S items (including the BONOBO delta-with-sparsify bound, the lambda1/lambda2 pairing rule and the SAMBAR kmin/kmax/sample rule), input_artifacts, handoff_targets, handoff_contract and conventions for D and U items, request-level limits (minimum samples, genes greater than samples, the 20,000,000-value LIONESS-DRAGON cap recomputed as F(F-1)/2 x samples), and the PARTIAL shapes and DECLINE rules in the brief. I checked that ASK items state the uncertain fact in a separate sentence with two contract outcomes not settled by a default or file check, that T uncertainties do not change the outcome, that CLARIFY items name no concrete result, and that S prompts describe settings by effect only. One prompt was edited to remove a sample-count ambiguity; no gold field needed correction.
